_README: Single source of truth for ArcticBlue speaker personas. Read by the Day-Of briefing route (api/briefing.py), baked into the tracker UI by src/build.py, and intended for the event-curator prompts too so the three never drift. Keys map 1:1 to the tracker's 'Fits: X' tags and the 'attendees' field. 'mode' forks the whole brief: room = work the floor; stage = earn/own the platform.
